_evidence: 0x51f424/0x51f45c set edi = 0 themselves ('mov edi,0') and pass it to the glyph writer 0x51d2ec, which stores through edi (stosb) when [0x89152b] == 1 (direct-buffer mode): the original faults at address 0 for that value, so the game never calls them in that mode.
